topic: Publishing deep technical posts and keeping them correct over time (reader suggestions, staleness signals) for solo technical authors: existing tools, complaints, workarounds, standout UX
purpose: 2-day demo scoping; competitor landscape + why existing tools fail
types_spec:
- type "landscape" (Who and what is in space X?): One row per named entity that plays a role in the space. Columns: "entity" (company, product, project, standard, or org), "category" (what kind of thing it is), "segment" (market/user segment it targets), "positioning" (how it is positioned or differentiated), "key_facts" (funding, size, launch date, adoption, as stated).
- type "comparison" (A vs B vs C?): One row per option x criterion cell the page actually states. Never infer missing cells. Columns: "option" (the thing being compared), "criterion" (the dimension compared on), "value" (the stated value/judgement for this option on this criterion).
- type "root_cause" (Why does X fail?): One row per symptom-cause pair. Columns: "symptom" (observable problem), "cause" (stated root cause), "evidence" (how the page shows it (log, repro, benchmark)), "fix" (stated fix or workaround).
